rationale: Schema first (the entity mapping is validated against it at startup), then the entity, then the service and API changes that depend on the entity, and finally the tests. The service and API change together in one task because the controller cannot compile against a half-changed service.

tasks.title: Add expires_at column
tasks.description: New Flyway migration V2 adding a nullable expires_at column to link.

tasks.title: Expiry on the Link entity
tasks.description: Map expires_at, add a constructor with expiry and isExpiredAt(Instant).

tasks.title: TTL on create and enforcement on resolve
tasks.description: LinkService computes expiresAt and enforces it on every resolve (cache hits included); ResolvedLink carries expiresAt; LinkExpiredException mapped to 410; request/response DTOs and controller updated.

tasks.title: Expiry tests
tasks.description: LinkTest for the predicate; LinkExpiryIntegrationTest with a controllable clock.
